visualCharacteristics.purpose: accordion whose panel splits its content into columns at each heading
traits: full-width collapsible row with a chevron
up to four link columns in the open panel

contentPattern.structure: One row per item. Cell 1: title. Cell 2: content; each heading (of the first heading level used, usually H3) starts a column, followed by its list of links. Content before the first heading spans all columns. A single-cell row uses its first element as the title. Zero-width characters are removed

usage.description: 'Popular destinations' SEO link panel above the footer.

reuseGuidance: Use when an accordion panel holds several parallel link lists. For plain stacked panel content use the vanilla accordion.
